policy: Every extension maps only to frozen family/parameter inventory. Same exact spelling/sequence all repeats and readers. No fresh opaque noun/action per occurrence. Assignments are an expensive exact whole codebook; they are not inferred grammar or translations.
extra_price_notes: EQUABLE denotes even distribution on the selected property; it is not an intermediate ordinal value opposed to HIGH or LOW. This is an explicit lexical interpretation obligation, not numerical evidence.
All extra exact aliases are charged even where their output family/parameter equals another form.
No q/ch wrappers have inferred meanings outside the specifically frozen qokaiin/chokaiin interface. Other q/ch-containing forms are full residuals.
No new time, condition, owner or causal-interface input enters through extensions.
